summary_oneline: HoobaToolkit: cookie-session aiohttp client over Hooba's public OpenAPI (draft invoices + draft purchase invoices) plus the catalogued Playwright operativa as fallback, and a BBVA-Excel→expense-draft pipeline — assembled from FEAT-453's shipped engine, not a new browser stack

localization.role: dynamic OpenAPI→tools generator; aiohttp transport via HTTPService; auth limited to bearer/apikey/basic
sanctioned aiohttp client (TID251-exempt); accepts cookies/headers per session — the transport for the REST half
pattern for binding a spec into a registrable OpenAPIToolkit subclass
catalogued deterministic Playwright/Selenium site actions; execute_web_task; credential_resolver; confirm_runs
domain-neutral operation engine: READ/DRAFT unattended, SUBMIT gated by ConfirmationGuard; run_operation/resume_operation; broker adapter
per-row ExecutionPlan import with digest-keyed manifest/resume; currently two-column, browser-operation bound
loads *.operation.json / *.template.json / *.flow.json from a private plans dir
fail-closed browser login, cookie export (bridge to REST session), file upload
the Playwright driver the web half runs on
sanctioned secret source for HOOBA_USERNAME/HOOBA_PASSWORD (vault/static resolvers, signed ledger)
UNTRACKED local Playwright operativa: WebBrowsingToolkit + navconfig credentials + 6-action catalog (login + 5 navigations, no data entry)
working login script (email/password selectors, credential_provider 'hooba', waits for /dashboard)
where the new 'hooba' toolkit gets registered
extras to compose (excel, scraping/playwright, business_automation) into a new hooba extra
httpx banned; new code must use aiohttp/HTTPService
FEAT-478 (unimplemented) contracts for BBVA parsing and AEAT deductibility that this feature must either reuse or provide a v1 of
the five Hooba web operations that were deferred out-of-repo and never written
217 relevant operations (Authentication, Invoice, PurchaseInvoice, Contact, Document, InboxFile, ...) extracted from https://api.hooba.com/api/doc.json

constraints.statement: Hooba's OpenAPI declares no securitySchemes; the only documented auth is POST /auth/login → session cookie (sid), plus undeclared headers (origin, x-hooba-language, ngsw-bypass) seen in the captured request
constraints.implication: OpenAPIToolkit cannot be used as-is: it has no cookie/session auth mode. Either extend it with a login hook + cookie jar, or build a thin HoobaClient on HTTPService and hand-curate tools.

constraints.statement: httpx is banned repo-wide (TID251); openapitoolkit.py and interfaces/http.py are per-file exemptions
constraints.implication: the new client uses aiohttp via HTTPService (or raw aiohttp); no new TID251 exemptions.

constraints.statement: Invoice and PurchaseInvoice creation endpoints yield state=draft; :issue and :confirm are separate POSTs
constraints.implication: 'borrador' maps 1:1 to the API's create calls (DRAFT-kind, unattended per D2); :issue/:confirm/:cancel/:delete are SUBMIT-kind and must stay out of v1 or behind ConfirmationGuard.

constraints.statement: 970 operations exist; generated tool names follow {service}_{method}_{path}
constraints.implication: auto-exposing the whole spec would flood the LLM tool budget; the toolkit must expose a curated set (≈10-15 typed tools) and at most one generic escape hatch.

constraints.statement: BusinessAutomationToolkit/D2: READ and DRAFT operations never touch the guard; SUBMIT always does, before the browser opens
constraints.implication: the same OperationKind vocabulary should classify API tools so a future submit path inherits the gate.

constraints.statement: FEAT-453 §8 resolved 'engine public / site plans private'; the brainstorm later placed HoobaServiceToolkit in parrot_tools/hooba/ with plans_dir out-of-repo
constraints.implication: an in-repo `parrot_tools/hooba/` package is already sanctioned; whether the Playwright catalog (selectors) may now be committed is an open decision (U1).

constraints.statement: The existing web operativa is untracked and navigation-only (login + 5 navigations); no draft_invoice/register_expense web plan exists
constraints.implication: 'use web for operations available via web' has almost nothing to route to today; the web half's v1 value is login/session recovery, PDF download, and uploads the API lacks.

constraints.statement: Existing bank-Excel ingest maps only client+amount columns to a browser operation; Spec A's BBVA parser (parse_bank_excel), AeatRule table and DeductibilityVerdict were never implemented (no FEAT-478 task index)
constraints.implication: the BBVA→expense-drafts capability needs a real BBVA layout parser and a rule table; it cannot merely call build_import_plan. Reuse of Spec A's contracts is a decision (U4).

constraints.statement: CredentialBroker + _credential_resolver_from_broker is the sanctioned credential path; the local example bypasses it with navconfig HOOBA_USERNAME/HOOBA_PASSWORD
constraints.implication: HOOBA_* env vars should feed a static broker provider ('hooba') used by both halves; never literal secrets in catalog JSON.

constraints.statement: New parrot_tools subpackages register in TOOL_REGISTRY and declare an optional extra; tests live under packages/ai-parrot-tools/tests/<pkg>/
constraints.implication: add 'hooba' to TOOL_REGISTRY, a hooba extra composing excel+scraping+business_automation, and tests/hooba/.

new: packages/ai-parrot-tools/src/parrot_tools/hooba/ — new subpackage (already anticipated by the auto-finance brainstorm impact table, F013)

hooba/client.py — HoobaClient on HTTPService/aiohttp: settings from HOOBA_ACCOUNT_ID/MEMBER_ID/USER_ID/SUBSCRIPTION_ID, login via POST /auth/login with credentials from CredentialBroker provider 'hooba', cookie jar (sid), explicit origin/x-hooba-language/ngsw-bypass headers, re-login on 401, GET /auth/check probe, account-scoped URL helper (F015, F009, F003)

hooba/models.py — Pydantic: InvoiceDraft/InvoiceLineDraft, PurchaseInvoiceDraft/PurchaseInvoiceLineDraft (gastos y compras), ContactRef, BankExpenseRow, ExpenseDraftBatch + a DraftReceipt with hooba ids and state (draft) (F015)

hooba/toolkit.py — HoobaToolkit(AbstractToolkit, auto_open) exposing a curated tool set: hooba_whoami/member, list_invoice_series, find_or_create_contact, create_invoice_draft(+lines), create_purchase_invoice_draft(+lines), attach_document, list_drafts, import_bbva_statement → drafts; every tool tagged with OperationKind (all DRAFT/READ in v1); a routing policy 'API when the endpoint exists, web action otherwise' (F006, F015)

hooba/web.py — thin adapter wiring WebBrowsingToolkit/BusinessAutomationToolkit with catalog_dir + broker-backed credential_resolver; v1 web operations: login/session-recovery (export sid via exec_get_cookies), download invoice PDF, and any upload the API lacks (F002, F007, F010)

hooba/bank/bbva.py — BBVA Excel layout parser (preamble-row detection, date/concept/amount/balance columns, digest via compute_statement_digest) → BankExpenseRow list; skips credits; dedupe by digest+row (F004, F005, F012)

hooba/rules/ — data-driven v1 deductibility rule table for autónomos (IVA/IRPF deducibility, simplified-invoice threshold, categories) mapping BankExpenseRow → PurchaseInvoiceDraft(simplified=…, subjectToIncomeTax=…, taxId=…) with legal_basis text; shape compatible with Spec A's AeatRule/DeductibilityVerdict (F005, F012) — pending U4
TOOL_REGISTRY['hooba'] + hooba extra in ai-parrot-tools pyproject (F011)
tests/hooba/: aiohttp test-server fixtures replaying the spec digest, BBVA anonymized fixture, rule-table tests, no-SUBMIT guarantee test (F011)
docs: hooba runbook section (env vars, spec version pin 2026.6.17, catalog location)

patterns_to_follow: Bound-subclass pattern from openapi_register._build_toolkit_subclass for any generated tools (F001)
auto_open=True + _open/_close for the HTTP session and the lazy browser (F006)
OperationKind tagging + D2 gate semantics for anything with legal effect (F006, F016)

integration_risks: Session semantics unknown at runtime (cookie TTL, CSRF, whether origin/ngsw-bypass headers are enforced): mitigate with GET /auth/check probe, re-login on 401, and an integration test behind HOOBA_LIVE=1 (F015)
Spec drift: version 2026.6.17, no servers block, Nelmio-generated — pin the digest, validate required fields at import, fail loudly on schema change (F015)
Tool-budget flood if the whole spec is exposed (970 ops) — curated surface (F001, F015)
invoice-lines body is a oneOf (product|title) and needs invoiceSerieId/contactId/taxId lookups first — tools must resolve ids (series, contact, tax) before creating drafts (F015)
BBVA layout parser is net-new; wrong column detection silently produces wrong drafts — row-count cross-check + reconcile + anonymized fixture (F004, F005)
Regulatory correctness of the deductibility table cannot be verified from the codebase — drafts only, legal_basis text on every draft, human review before :confirm (F012, F005)
Public/private seam: committing the Playwright catalog with real selectors conflicts with FEAT-453 §8 unless re-decided (F008, F016)

recommended_next_command.rationale: Localization is high-confidence, the engine and transport already exist, and the API removes the need for new browser data-entry; the remaining forks (U1-U5) are product decisions answerable in Q&A rather than architectural unknowns needing a brainstorm.

meta.notes: Overall confidence capped at medium because C3 (session auth), C9-C11 (tool surface, web role, BBVA mapping) are inferred and the external API was never exercised with credentials. F015 is external evidence (public spec), not codebase evidence. Wall-clock budget was exceeded only because of the interactive plan gate; all 38 planned queries plus 3 depth-1 follow-ups executed, so the run is not truncated.
